title: Three purchase events
fullTitle: One Click. Three Purchase Events. Here’s What Went Wrong.

captions.text: One completed order. Three received purchase envelopes.
Same event, same transaction ID, three senders.
Rewind: one click, one completed order, one confirmation screen.
Three emitters: app handler, tag-manager trigger, component mount.
Each sent its own envelope to the collector.
emitter: three sources · ts: milliseconds apart
Several components claim ownership of one business event.
3 raw envelopes ≠ 3 GA4 conversions. GA4 documents purchase dedup by transaction_id (web).
That covers purchase, not every event. It hides duplication; it does not fix it.
One authoritative emitter: the handler that runs when the order completes.
Remove the tag-manager trigger. Remove the mount-handler emission.
The component still renders. It no longer reports.
Retest: complete the same order, then remount the component twice.
Tested scenario only. Not exactly-once across reloads, retries or devices.
Order-level idempotency is a separate design concern.
Fix the emitters. Then verify the reporting.
